text: Entry 1463 adds forceEmailScheduling to the manager's propsToCopy list. The accepted list retains it and copies each value before registering the replacement. Reordering the dialog alone would not preserve a setting omitted from that list. For this replacement path, recommend checking both write order and copy coverage for every persistent UI setting. This is a scoped state-transfer rule; no cache-toggle or remote scheduling test was run. No test, build or runtime operation was run.
